reviews.text: Friendly staff. Affordable prices. I recommend this place for anyone, especially first-time pet owners.
Hands down the best Amazing Animal Hospital Ever everyone there were soooo nice and caring for Our Ferret Winter
Took care of our St Bernard asap before infection spread same day ....very serious and she's doing fine now...good people!
Thanks for the top rating! We're happy to know you enjoyed your experience with us. We can't wait to see you and your pet again!

Staff very welcoming and friendly. All are obvious animal lovers. Gave my new rescue gentle, tender loving care. Explained options going forward without hard upsell. The extent of care is left up to the owner. Pup and I have found a family vet. A scheduling faux pas was somewhat frustrating. Then I was over it.
NCAH is the best in the valley! I highly advise them to anyone looking for an excellent Vet Clinic with top of the line doctors and staff. I would give them 10 stars if it was an option!

Is there a way to give zero stars? If you like being on hold for over 90 minutes and being left with zero answers then this is the place for you. If you’re looking for quality, honesty and professionalism, this is NOT the place. Avoid it at all costs!!
Over charge. Look at your bill.
Love the staff, especially Brenda and Alex whom I’ve known for many years since I’ve been going. They take great care of my ferrets, Bonkers, Bananas, and Berzerk!
This is the best place to take your pets to.  I have all the confidence in the world that you'll love this place too!
We appreciate the 5-star review! It's great to know you had a good visit. Hope to welcome you and your pet back at our clinic!
We appreciate the 5-star review! It's great to know you enjoyed your visit. We hope to welcome you and your pet back to our clinic in the future.
I am happy with the vet and their staff.

Just transferred care of my 2 year old chihuahua mix Cocoa. Moved from west side to central Phoenix a year and a half ago and I think, NO, I know I have found the place for her care.  Everyone was so nice and professional. Dr Frank was great and very knowledgeable.

North Central Animal Hospital cares for your pets as if it’s their own. The doctors, vet techs and staff are committed to providing the very best care and treatment for your pets. I highly recommend this Veterinary Hospital. They are excellent.
Very nice and knowledgeable staff and veterinarians

Worst vet I will never go back. Long story short... They told me my hen wasn't egg bound and gave me a $2000 estimate for tests they needed to run. Ended up putting her down and didn't need to. She was egg bound. If they don't know anything about chickens they shouldn't claim to. I wonder how they live with themselves. Preying on the emotions of people that love their pets.

I had such a great experience bringing my dog here. We got a same-day appointment and were taken right into a room when we arrived, which I appreciated so much. When your pet isn’t feeling well, that really matters.

Everyone was kind and knowledgeable, and they truly met me where I was. I never felt pressured into unnecessary testing or treatment, and they helped me find a plan that made sense for Jackson.

I left feeling like he was genuinely in good hands. I’ve never had such a positive experience with an animal hospital, and I’m so grateful for the care we received.
Very caring towards animals and people.
Neighborhood vet. Small parking space. Nice vet.

Do not use this vet. They do not care about the animals, just your money. Our little dog was a several year patient of theirs and when she was attacked by a larger dog, I had to beg the doctor to let me come in ("they were very busy"). Then, when all of her stitches and drainage tube came apart two days (and several hundreds of dollars) later, they couldn't do anything as the "were short staffed" that day. Fortunately we found another vet in the neighborhood (who could not figure out why our dog was stitched up incorrectly) who saved our dog's life. Obviously, we've never gone back and we love our new vet.

Brought in my crazy, anxious German Shepherd today for his updated rabies vaccine. The staff was very kind and gentle despite his protective/aggressive disposition. I’m very glad I picked their vaccine clinic !

I was very disappointed with my experience at this clinic. My appointment was scheduled for 8:30 AM, and I arrived 10 minutes early. The reason for the visit was a minor abrasion on my dog's leg, which I had clearly noted before arriving.

Despite having an appointment, the veterinarian didn't come in to see my dog until close to 9:00 AM. I wasn't given a treatment plan until around 10:00 AM, and my dog wasn't taken back for her shots until approximately 10:05. After that, I was left waiting in the exam room until about 10:40 AM, at which point I had to ask if we were finished and whether I could leave.

There is no reason a routine appointment for a minor issue should take more than two hours, especially when the actual interactions with staff and the veterinarian totaled perhaps 20 minutes. The excessive waiting made an already stressful experience much worse for my dog, who is anxious in veterinary settings.

I also felt there was a strong emphasis on recommending additional services and treatments. While I understand that options should be presented, it often felt like the priority was increasing the bill rather than focusing on my dog's specific needs and comfort.

Overall, the lack of efficiency, communication, and consideration for my dog's experience left me frustrated. I expect better time management and more attention to the well-being of anxious pets.

We've been bringing our beloved pet companions in to North Central Animal Hospital for close to twenty-five years. Dr. Harriet Frank always cared for our Max (the GSP), and the many cats that we've lived with over the years. The service and level of care has always been exemplary.
A nightmare! They lack communication and charge a lot for a place that doesn't know what they're doing with exotics.
Nice staff and service but that was to be expected.  I haven't had a pet for a few years so the prices were a bit of a shock.  This is a new vet for me.

I have lived here for 5 years from a very small town and this is the only place I'll bring my pets. They have delt wit me and sometimes my attitude wit compassion, urgency, and love for my pets! Prescriptions, or watevr I've never had to wait. Drop in wit a problem? Worked in immediately, if possible. Even when I lost my 15 yr old pet, the girls at the front desk let me gripe to them about something I had misunderstood n blamed them for, AND THEY WERE STILL PATIENT!! This is the place to take your pets for sure! Thx for 5 years and hopefully lots more!! I appreciate yaw!!
Took us in early on an emergency. Thank you for helping Ginger early.

The staff went above and beyond as well as the vet Hillary.  They took the time to look my husky over and discovered things my other vet missed.  Big issues.  They were so very gentle and patient with him.  They took the time to explain everything they found and suggested. I walked away with a full heart and relief. I would recommend them to anyone

bait and switch operation.  paid $524 for prelim blood tests prior to surgery on an umbrella cockatoo.  when I arrive the cost of the surgery went from $830 to $1158 with nothing changed.  They offered to do it for $888 but then recanted.   I walked out in digust due to the lack of professionalism.  I am out the $524 which I had previously paid for the blood work because the original cost of surgery was not honored.  not mention the several hundred $$ previouly paid for fees and office visits.  steer clear of this place, I was totally reasonable and was ready to pay the extra add on from $830 to $888 but the $1158 was too much to bear.  I felt like I was at a bad used car dealer.  This is very bad behavior a total rip off feigning care and concern for you pets.  very low character.

Thank you, Sue, for your generous 5-star rating! Your support means a lot to us, and we’re thrilled to hear that your experience was a positive one. We're committed to creating meaningful connections and helping others, and your feedback inspires us to continue our efforts.

The staff here is great. My girls always get excellent care. I can ask lots of questions, never feel rushed, and they give me all the options. When my dogs have a procedure or vaccines, they always follow-up the next day to see how they’re doing.

They were caring and awesome more than I expected and made me feel like it was just about my fur baby Kindle at the time! They were patient and kind. Thanks to all the staff there but especially to Dr.kenyon and her assistant Megan

I am so HAPPY to have found this place. Everyone is absolutely AMAZING!! Thank you to everyone at the front desk to the Techs & to Dr.Kenyon. It has been absolute pleasure. Thank you for always being consistent… You’re all appreciated!!!! See ya Saturday.
Wonderful staff and vet technicians.   They cared for our bird lovingly.
Thank you, Ly, for your wonderful 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are delighted to hear that your experience with us was positive. Your loyalty means a lot to us!

Thank you, Zach, for your generous 5-star rating! We truly value your support and are delighted to hear that your experience was a positive one. Your feedback inspires us to continue putting the needs of others first.

An unfortunate situation, but a grateful experience with the team at the hospital. Driving back to work during rush hour, I witnessed a small dog getting hit by a car and the driver taking off. I quickly pulled over and rushed towards the dog hoping to perform CPR on him. Unfortunately he passed right then and there so without questioning I rushed him to the nearest vet hospital, North Central Animal Hospital to get help. Their team was quick to come out and check if the little guy had a chip which he did. Their team immediately went to the source to retrieve information regarding the owner and pups name. Due to the info on his chip number everything was not up to date so a few calls had to be made as I waited in the parking lot at the hospital. Their staff helped me on what the next steps were and because I or them could not get ahold of the owners they were incredibly helpful on keeping the pup with them until the owner reached out, if anyone would. A huge thank you to them for stepping up and helping as it was a sudden and unfortunate situation. Highly recommend this hospital and the wonderful staff to help out with your fur babies.
The staff is amazing! They always check up on my puppy after any shots just to make sure she’s doing well.
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Mark! We're so glad to hear about your positive experience. Your support means a lot to us, and we can't wait to work together again as a team.

The staff is very kind but they rake u over the coals with the prices and try to talk u into a year membership at seventy bucks a month for u to avoid paying and additional six hundred bucks for a tooth extraction.  Guess what ...they succeeded.  Not to worry...ur only roped in for a year.
Very thorough with explaining the tests that were going to be taken as-well as thorough with explaining why said tests were being done for my  “frug” (French bulldog/pug)
Love seeing the stability of the staff, which says a lot about a place. All the folks are very helpful, positive, mostly female (important) and genuinely care about your pet.
Always great care and concern for our Lallo. Kono is feeling so much better. Always the best care!
Thank you, Mike, for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to hear that your experience with us met your expectations. Consistency is important to us, and we appreciate your feedback!

I know they will always do whatever is necessary to do what is needed for them. Some examples include trying to hurry me to buy expensive meds before test results are back, expensive dental treatments when my cat has had perfect teeth until then, and even trying to get me to buy meds when test results came back negative.

We took our older dog there the other day and we're very very impressed with the experience. They spent so much time with us between the doctor and the tech! Our pup has a growth on her gums and they gave us all these options and or just palliative care. Thank you!!

This is the only business I will take my pets to I have had two cats spayed and recently brought my tuxedo in for an eye injury staff is very friendly and supportive also on the second note the clinic is very clean and orderly

Not have a Tech come in with 3 different prices and trying to  up sell me on things my Cat already had done. I gave them all of my paper work from Sunburst and all of the up to date vaxes prior to being put in an examine room. They never read anything I left Arrowhead Animal Hospital, many years ago because they did the same thing. My God. What a disappoint this place was. It was all about the money and not the pet. I'm being honest with this review and upfront.  8/29/2025

Took our ailing cat to this business. Found the initial diagnosis very vague so we agreed to perform additional tests.
Complete package was $1800, we agreed to just the basics of blood and imaging ($900).
The blood test took 3 days to process, yet the results took 9 additional days to share them with us. All the while, we were struggling to understand what was wrong with our pet. We called and called again, only to be told "someone will call you soon.'
Inexcusable to leave us in the dark for over a week while waiting for a possible cancer diagnosis.
No surprise that they recommended more tests.  Won't use this business for any additional services and strongly discourage others to use them either.

Updated review 06/21/25: I’ve been taking my bunny’s to North Central Animal Hospital for several years now and always see Dr. Ivy Thomas. She’s an amazing veterinarian and has a plethora of knowledge regarding small mammals. She treats my bunny’s with such care and is always very thorough when we visit. She is always teaching me something new when we come in for a check-up and you can tell just how deeply she cares about the animals she treats. It’s a bonus that she loves my Lionhead bunny, Snowball, and gives him extra affection every time she sees him and that she loves his sassy personality as much as I do.
Dr. Thomas is probably the best veterinarian I’ve gone to and I love that she is always sharing articles about bunny’s with me to help me further my knowledge on them too. Dr. Thomas always goes above and beyond, that includes having hard conversations and being very caring in the way she speaks to you about your pet and their health. She really does want the best for all of her patients and I appreciate that more than I can put into words.
Dr. Thomas is the most bunny-savvy veterinarian I’ve ever been to (and I’ve been to quite a few in an effort to find someone I was comfortable with) and I plan on visiting her for many years to come.

Thank you for caring so deeply and loving my bunny’s as much as I do Dr. Thomas, your hard work, dedication, and compassion shine through every time we visit the hospital.

I have a bunny and I adopted him back in 2018. I’ve always struggled to find a vet who would actually listen to my concerns without brushing things off. Bunnies are considered exotic pets and need specialized care/treatment. I felt that, until coming to North Central, only the bare minimum was being done for my bunny when I would take him for an annual check-in or even an emergency.
Everyone working at North Central was really nice and friendly. The vet who saw my bunny, Dr. Thomas, and her vet tech. were SO thorough and knowledgeable. Both seemed to genuinely care about my bunny’s health and answered all of my questions in-depth. They not only listened to my concerns, but did their own analysis and walked me through the best plan of action to get my bunny back to 100% health - this is something no other practice has done for me, seriously. I plan to continue bringing my bunny, and future pets, to this vet and anyone else who has exotics should strongly consider them too.

Great staff, awesome Doc!  Super helpful and kind to my pups and myself.  They listed out everything they found, (teeth cleaning, allergies, etc.) and no guilt or hard sell at all to get added services.  Glad I found North Central Animal Hospital!!!

They had availability right away, but our overall experiences were not great…

*It was hard getting a person on the phone in order to schedule a visit.

*The office staff kept asking for information we already provided. Maybe there is a communication disconnect.

*It was difficult to get in touch with a doctor for follow-up. It took like 5 days and it wasn’t even the doctor who called.

*A doctor never did follow through with letting us know of a suggested medication that she wanted to research for us. When asked, we were told to pay for a new vet visit.

*Our pet saw 2 doctors and neither ended up suggesting medications when they were needed. Only shots were provided.

*We kept getting suggested expensive services, that we had turned down 3 times in 1 visit.

They're pretty quick about setting up appointments and everyone is nice BUT I did ask for a quote before coming in though, turns out the service was more than double what they told me over the phone so just watch out for that I guess. (I was told it was going to be ~$300 for the services I wanted, then at the end of the visit I get the bill and its ~$900 for what I asked, and over $3000 for everything else they were suggesting I do lmao). Ended up getting out only paying $450 ish and not even doing everything I wanted to do. I seriously do not recommend this place, honestly forgot why I stopped coming here lmao.

Only go here if you have an extra $86 stuck deep inside of your posterior. They will pull it right out of you! Just gotta open nice & wide.

I found a stray dog and my partner suggested we give it a rabies shot, just in case.

We scheduled a rabies shot appointment with this clinic for $18 online. They advertised low cost vaccines.

When I got there with, mind you, a stray animal that I’m still desperately trying to learn how to help avoid biting, scratching, or otherwise hurting anybody or breaking anything, they handed me a form. On the form, there was a list of services listed with check mark lines next to them. There was ONE line that they marked with an X indicating that, if I sign, I’m getting the stray a rabies shot for $18. There were other lines on the form - none of the others were marked with an X.

In the moment, I didn’t have the wherewithal to realize that, above these check mark spaces, there is a portion indicating that I was agreeing to an $86 dollar “exam fee”. Yes, I’m a fool, because it was bolded and I missed it. But the 45lb. stray pitbull yanking on the leash I was trying to cling to was a little distracting as I tried to complete the form if I’m being honest. I also never thought that an animal clinic in Sunnyslope advertising low cost vaccinations would make the process anything but transparent and above board.

What’s the $86 for? Good question. For my $86… was I given a copy of the vet’s notes? Nope. A list of recommended ways to help the poor animal I’m trying to help? No. Anything of use to the animal or myself? No.

I got a receipt. Nothing else.

They got their money and now they’re getting a poor review that they earned every single letter of. It took me everything I had to abstain from getting angry and raising my voice, because that $86 was most of the money that my partner and I had for groceries this week. Guess what kids? Meatless spaghetti and Kraft macaroni & cheese next handful of days - yippee. A “professional” took the grocery money so she could tell me that nothing was wrong with the stray dog I’m trying to care for.

Again, I went for an $18 rabies shot. The rabies shot doesn’t only help us, but the community, if she gets out again. Hopefully she doesn’t. She’s perfect and sweet.

This place, on the other hand… not so much. What an awful experience. I’ll never go back.

Legitimate businesses providing valuable services don’t need to slip in fees hoping that people are “too dumb to notice.” There are reasons people don’t notice - for example, they trusted that you just cared for animals. Good businesses let their services speak for themselves and earn the continued business of new clients. If this clinic cared at all, they’d make it clear - especially for those of us just trying to do the right thing by caring for a STRAY ANIMAL - that they want the $86 + the $18 rabies shot fee.

I hope they get a better handle on basic ethical business practices and soon. Lots of strays out there and the poor idiots who save them are already taking on an unexpected and unplanned expense.

I’ve been taking my pets here for a year now. Prices at the last check up visit was astronomical. They offered me their Petly plan, didn’t give me all the information, and then denied me service following me cancelling my Petly plan.  I lost out on hundreds of dollars and the way they presented that I couldn’t bring my pets here to get treated anymore was poorly unprofessional. Absolutely would not recommend, find somewhere cheaper.
They have taken great care of my cockatoo and have kept her alive when gravely ill.

Very educational and direct. They even took him back to say hi to everyone and you could tell they really love animal here. They showed me how to administer meds and said I could come back anytime for a demonstration. Appreciate what they are doing for my sick baby boy!
Great experience, for his 1st time to a vet. My doggo.

Beware!!! You do not want to bring your birds here. Very upset with everything I experienced with this vet.

I brought my beautiful (never sick a day in her life) Quaker to this Avian vet because my little girl was Egg bound. When I first arrived they put me in a room and tell me the doctor would be right in. A woman came in, took one look at my bird and told me my bird was in prolapse. She told me this was very bad and there’s not much they can do. I said are you sure I was told that she is just egg bound? She said well she could be that too. Let me look. She took my bird and begins to look with a Q-tip in side her to see what the problem is. She then says to me oh yes, she is just egg bound not prolapsed. She tells me she is not the avian doctor, she is her assistant, but she’s been doing this for 13 years so she will handle my bird. They took my bird to the back and said they would be back shortly with an estimate. When they came back in, they gave me an estimate for $2200!!!!  I told them that that is ridiculous and I don’t have that kind of money. They asked me what I could afford I said maybe $700. They left the room and magically came back with an estimate that was now $780. They said that included keeping my little girl overnight. I agreed and I left planning on returning in the morning to see the actual vet.  Within 30 minutes, I received a phone call that my girl had passed her egg. Then 15 minutes later I received a phone call that my bird had died. I talked to quite a few bird owners and breeders about my situation and my bird that was egg bound for less than 24 hours should not have died. Very suspicious. I do not hold them responsible for her death because I could never know what actually killed her. But I certainly do not feel a vet assistant was the proper hands for my bird to be in. To top off this horrible story I have now gotten a copy of the bill. This company had the nerve to charge me $70 for hospitalization 24 hours for them caring for my bird for less than an hour. When I questioned them, they couldn’t care less!
Absolutely Shameful!!!
Unfortunately, there are so many vets out there that are just interested in making money from vulnerable pet owners. Praying on people who would do anything to save their baby! In my opinion, this is one of those places.
Trust me, avoid them like the plague.
Sami and the staff were great! Patient and caring with my scared pittie lap dog.

The staff is amazing, nice and friendly! My pups like them and I love that they also text back if I have any questions or concerns lol 😊 …
